data.font_embedding_method: matplotlib subset-embedding of Noto Sans SC (SIL OFL-1.1) glyph outlines into PDF/PNG outputs; the 4 HTML deliverables embed a Noto Sans SC subset woff2 as @font-face{font-family:'JZEmbedCJK'} data-URIs (OFL-1.1 compliant); no proprietary/system font (e.g. PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei) is embedded — only the OFL font subset is shipped inline; no standalone .woff2/.ttf binary is distributed as a separate file

embedded_font_sources.name: Noto Sans SC
embedded_font_sources.embedding_basis: Noto Sans SC is licensed under SIL OFL-1.1, which explicitly permits redistribution (modified or unmodified) and subset embedding within the submission; the glyph subsets embedded in PDF/PNG derive from this OFL font

data.font_license_note: This submission uses Noto Sans SC (SIL Open Font License 1.1) as the rendering font across all asset layers. PDF/PNG deliverables embed glyph subsets via matplotlib (font manifest NotoSansSC, weights 400/700). The 4 HTML deliverables embed a Noto Sans SC subset woff2 (1245 chars: 1126 CJK + 88 ASCII + 31 symbols; Regular 160 KB + Bold 164 KB → base64 213 KB + 218 KB) as @font-face{font-family:'JZEmbedCJK'} data URIs (src local-first + data-URI fallback; plus an html,body,body * catch-all rule so inherited text also hits the embedded font; font-family stack explicitly hits every element — issue #3978 verified parameters). The package does NOT ship a standalone font binary; the subset is inlined as base64 in each HTML. The full OFL-1.1 text is reproduced in report/copyright_statement.md; stable license/source URLs are provided. Reserved Font Name 'Noto Sans SC' is retained (OFL §1 Reservation of Name). Per itemized status this font use is 'documented + pending legal re-review', not self-certified as fully cleared.
data.code_license: Generation scripts released under MIT License in ltf0109/urban-planning-ai-kit.
data.clearance_conclusion: Evidence-proportionate, itemized — NOT an 'all assets cleared' assertion (v15). All submitted text/geometry/code/metrics/multimodal figures are original works by EvidenceRail Agent (ltf0109) and its subagents, with no third-party generative-AI assets of unclear ownership. For usable_for_formal=no background-only sources (HAIDIAN-*/ORIGIN-*/HERITAGE-*/SANQU-LIANGYI), only their viewpoints/mechanistic inspiration are cited — no third-party asset is copied or redistributed, and they are not used as formal evidence or formal claims. The seven TOP-*/DZDP entries with no stable permalink were deleted in v13; their mechanism-heuristic prose is retained as common urban-planning knowledge, not as sourced claims. Per-asset itemized status (v15): ① font = Noto Sans SC, OFL-1.1, license text shipped, Reserved Font Name retained — status 'documented + pending legal re-review'; ② AMap / Tianditu aggregate data = REMOVED in v16/v17: all 23 AMap-derived metrics and map data layers (POI / station / Moran / Gi* / H3 res9 grids / GCJ-02→WGS-84 conversions) were deleted from the package; no AMap/Tianditu data remains in any deliverable — status 'removed, no AMap/Tianditu data in submission' (removal record in sources.json AMAP-TIANDITU-DERIVED-DATA-REMOVED); ③ OSM = REMOVED from the current build (v15): osm_roads_basemap.geojson drawing and the '© OpenStreetMap (ODbL)' footer were removed from generate_boards.py; no OSM tiles or OSM-derived data remain in any deliverable (PNG/PDF/HTML); osm_roads_basemap.geojson exists only in the working directory and is not shipped — status 'no OSM data in submission'. Nothing here is represented as completed clearance. Professional legal itemized review is a REQUIRED precondition (not optional) before formal exhibition/publication (copyright_statement.md v15 §2.2).
